text:
بن کشتی سمندر تردے غرق تھیندے ملاحا،
بن جاماں سفر کماوݨ، نہیں عقلی صلاحا۔
romanized:
Bin kishtī samundar tarde gharak thīnde malāhā,
Bin jāmāṅ safar kamāwaṇ, nahīṅ aklī salāhā.
literal_en:
Boatmen who swim in the deep river without a boat get out of breath.
Travelling without clothes is not a wise thing to do.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
